request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red royal robe becomes near-black charcoal with a thin bright violet trim along its collar and torn hem, open at the chest so his pale warm ivory ribcage shows; the crown becomes dull tarnished bronze; the orb of flame above his head and his eye sockets glow bright violet, and nothing blue is left. Keep the skull, the bone arms, hands and feet, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
